title: Add support for CareSens Air CGM
body:
Is it possible to add (or confirm full support for) the CareSens Air CGM in xDrip+?
It seems to work via the official app, but it’s unclear whether xDrip+ has proper native support or if it still relies on notification/companion app workarounds.
If not fully supported yet: would direct BLE integration or improved integration be possible in the future?

Thanks for all your work on xDrip+!

comments.body: We ask you not to open an issue in this repository.  It is unfortunate that you either missed that or chose to ignore it.
